set_aside.subject: activate_budget_version
set_aside.text: activate_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST use only BudgetRepository, the budgets repository of that transaction, for budget persistence and ProjectSectionRepository, the project_sections repository of that transaction, for project-section persistence; the project's expenses are read only through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository, called with project_id, and allocations MUST be flattened from those ExpenseAggregate values.
set_aside.other_text: Only import runtime model symbols from core.models when they are explicitly listed in IMPORTS.
set_aside.question: Either restore ExpenseAggregate to the core.models IMPORTS or remove the note's direct runtime-symbol reference and describe the returned aggregate values without naming ExpenseAggregate.
